title: Performance Enhanced
description: A Simple Minecraft Modpack Focusing On enhancing FPS As mush as possible While Keeping it Vanilla
body:
Performance

Performance Enhanced Supports Most Features Like Shaders, Extended Render Distance. Pretty Much Most Of optifine Features.

Keeping it Vanilla

This Modpack Is as Vanilla As it can Get, No game Changing Mods or textures, It focuses On Getting as much FPS As possible While keeping it looking Like normal! 

compatibility

This Modpack Has no Content Mods, Keeping it as Compatable as Possible. Two mods That Wont work are Vulkan And Better Block entities. Due to having Sodium

Keeping up-to-date
Performance Enhanced tries its best To try and Stay Up to the Newest Minecraft Version With updates To any Broken Mods

Fabric API
Performance Enhanced Keeps on Fabric API To Let Users Add there Own Mods, And because Fabric is Fast and Lightweight.

(If Uploading a Modpack Using Performance Enhanced Make sure to Credit it)
